subject: Request: restore chronology, KMS access logs, and RPO verification checklist
messages:
From: Audit Support <auditsupport@clearwave.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request for restore chronology and RPO evidence (incident window Oct 20)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of Clearwave's operational resilience review we need evidence for the Oct 20th failover/restore event to validate RTO/RPO assertions in your SOC2 documentation. Specifically we're asking for: 

- A restore chronology (minute-resolution) from detection -> failover -> restore completion
- S3 snapshot manifests and checksums for the recovery point(s) used
- KMS access logs showing which principals requested/decrypted snapshots within the window (Oct 20 02:00 - Oct 20 08:00 UTC)
- DB logical replication/pg_wal positions or equivalent showing replication lag at failover
- KV cache warm-up timeline and latency profile (time-to-warm by shard)
- Any post-restore verification scripts/logs that confirm data consistency

If you can supply artifacts (CSV/text/manifests) and schedule a short 30-minute witness call this week that would be ideal. Please let us know the format you prefer for the manifests (S3 inventory vs. manifest file) and whether KMS logs can be redacted for principals.

Thanks,
Claire Ross
Audit Support
Clearwave Financial

Attachment: evidence-request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Audit Support <auditsupport@clearwave.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request for restore chronology and RPO evidence (incident window Oct 20)

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can provide those items. Looping in Laura (Ops lead) and Connor (SRE) who will assemble the artifacts and provide the technical narrative.

Quick clarifying items:
- Time window: you requested Oct 20 02:00-08:00 UTC. Do you also need the preceding 6 hours (pre-failure baseline) for replication lag? We can include Oct 19 20:00-08:00 UTC as an option.
- KMS logs: we can provide the CloudHSM/KMS access events (principal, API, timestamp) and are happy to redact principal emails, but we cannot remove key IDs or the fact of key usage. Will that work?
- Manifest format: we typically provide an S3 snapshot manifest (text) + a CSV restore timeline. We can also export the database WAL positions as a small TSV.

Proposed next steps:
1) Connor to drop the artifacts (restore timeline CSV, snapshot manifest, KV warmup PDF) into a secure share and paste links here.
2) Laura to provide the human-readable runbook excerpt and the post-restore verification report.
3) Schedule a 30-min witness call tomorrow 10:30-11:00 PT (13:30-14:00 ET).

If that works I will confirm and send the secure links.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference

Attachment: placeholder-ack.txt (stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Audit Support <auditsupport@clearwave.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request for restore chronology and RPO evidence (incident window Oct 20)

Claire / team — attaching the artifacts to the secure share now. Short summary of what's included: 

- redwood-restore-timeline-20261020.csv (attachment stub): minute-resolution timeline from alert -> mitigation -> restore completion. Columns: utc_ts, event, service, actor, note.
- s3-snapshot-manifest-20261020.txt (attachment stub): manifest of S3 objects used for the restore with checksums. We also include the S3 inventory report for the bucket.
- kv-warmup-latency-20261020.pdf (attachment stub): per-shard warm-up latency and cumulative cache hit-rate over the first 15 minutes post-restore.
- db-wal-positions.tsv (link in share): pg_wal positions sampled every 30s for the 12-hour window.
- kms-access-logs-excerpt.csv (link in share): KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, principal arn, timestamp, key-id. We redacted user email addresses but left IAM role names and ARNs intact.
- post-restore-verification.log (link): output of our consistency checks and checksums.

Notes and caveats: 
- Replication lag: our logical replication monitoring showed < 25s median lag in the 6 hours prior; at failover the tail spiked to ~2m40s for a small set of partitions (details in CSV). The restore used the latest consistent snapshot up to 2026-10-20T02:45:00Z (manifest included).
- KMS: we rotated the active data key two weeks prior; rotation entries are included in the KMS log excerpt. We cannot provide decrypted payloads but can show the key usage and key-id chain.

Secure links (expires in 7 days):
- https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/Compliance/Docs/restore-pack-20261020 (zip with all artifacts)
- JIRA-SUP-3245 (internal ticket with timeline and checklist)

I can join the witness call to walk through the WAL positions and the manifest checksums. Suggested witness list: myself (SRE), Jordan (Ops lead), Claire (Audit).

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs): redwood-restore-timeline-20261020.csv; s3-snapshot-manifest-20261020.txt; kv-warmup-latency-20261020.pdf

From: Claire Ross <auditsupport@clearwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, drc-team@clearwave.com
Date: 2026-11-13T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request for restore chronology and RPO evidence (incident window Oct 20)

Jordan/Connor — this is great, thanks for the thorough package. A few follow-ups before the witness call: 

1) KMS logs - we need confirmation that key rotation events (key-version metadata) are included and that the audit chain shows which key-id encrypted each snapshot. The KMS excerpt you provided looks fine; please make sure the rotation table is included in the zip (key-id, rotation_ts, previous_key_id).

2) For the WAL positions: on the witness call we will ask one of you to demonstrate how the positions map back to the manifest checksums and why the chosen snapshot is consistent. Please have a small script or query ready (sample commands are fine).

3) KV cache warmup - the PDF is helpful. Please include the raw CSV that produced the graphs (we request raw data for verification).

4) Witness list — Claire and two engineers from our resilience team will join. 10:30 PT tomorrow works. Please send a calendar invite with a secure dial-in and indicate if we should access the share prior to the call.

Thanks — we should be able to close this section of the review after the call assuming everything lines up.

Regards,
Claire Ross
Audit Support, Clearwave Financial

Attachment: requested-data-form.pdf (stub)
